name: fmp_historical_market_cap
description:
Market capitalisation history for one company from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP), one value per date.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/historical-market-cap as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, sent as given, e.g. AAPL), limit (integer; sent only when given).
For the current value use fmp_market_cap.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "limit": 30}
